answer: An honest agent and one of a spammer's three hundred names both forecast the flow delta of a new shale well, and they post the same number. Until the meter reads, nothing separates them. The council never counts how many names agree. It weighs each forecaster by how close it came on wells already tapped. The honest agent has a season of hits behind it, while the spammer's crowd stands like a trellis with nothing growing on it: a lot of frame and no weight in the decision.
